subtitle: When a Poet Turned a City into Song

panels.shot: epic wide shot from a high terrace, overlooking bustling ancient Madurai at dusk
panels.action: Mankudi Maruthanar stands on a stone terrace looking over sprawling Sangam-era Madurai with crowded streets, shrines, markets and the Vaigai beyond, his palm-leaf manuscript rolled in one hand.

dialogue.text: In the age of three rival crowns, one poet made Madurai itself the hero of his song.

i18n.hi: तीन ताजों के ज़माने में, एक कवि ने मदुरै को ही अपने गान का नायक बना दिया।

panels.shot: slow push-in from above, revealing the triangular city walls and gates
panels.action: A bird’s-eye view shows Madurai’s fortified walls with three main gates, crowded causeways leading to them, and the river Vaigai curving past the city like a silver ribbon.

dialogue.text: Maduraikanci calls it the city of the three gates, where streets pour into walls like rivers into the sea.

i18n.hi: मदुरैकाञ्चि इसे तीन द्वारों का शहर कहता है, जहाँ गलियाँ दीवारों में ऐसे उतरती हैं जैसे नदियाँ समुंदर में।

panels.shot: intimate interior shot in a modest house, lamplight on the poet
panels.action: Young Mankudi Maruthanar sits cross-legged in a simple house, palm-leaf strips before him, as an older patron or messenger speaks; an oil lamp throws warm light over his focused face.

dialogue.text: From the village of Mankudi on the Vaigai came Maruthanar, summoned to praise the Pandya king of Madurai.

i18n.hi: वैगई के किनारे मानकुडी गाँव से आया मरुथनार, मदुरै के पांड्य राजा की स्तुति के लिए बुलाया गया।

panels.shot: medium shot in the court hall, low angle on the king and poet
panels.action: Inside a pillared hall, the Pandya king sits on a low throne, courtiers around; Maruthanar stands respectfully, holding his palm-leaf roll, eyes quietly observant rather than deferential.

dialogue.text: He was asked for a panegyric. Instead of only a king, he chose a city to praise.

i18n.hi: उससे बड़ाई माँगी गई थी। सिर्फ़ राजा नहीं, उसने तो पूरे शहर की प्रशंसा चुनी।

panels.shot: wide street-level shot, eye-level, immersing us in the market
panels.action: A bustling Madurai marketplace fills the frame: vendors with baskets of fish, rice, and flowers; potters and weavers at work; ox-carts jostling; Maruthanar walks through, quietly watching.

dialogue.text: Maduraikanci builds its praise from the ground up, beginning with streets where every craft has its place.

i18n.hi: मदुरैकाञ्चि ज़मीन से शुरू होकर शहर की तारीफ़ गढ़ता है, उन गलियों से जहाँ हर हुनर की अपनी जगह है।

panels.shot: tracking street shot, slight low angle, showing specialized lanes
panels.action: The scene shows distinct lanes: one of goldsmiths shaping ornaments, another of garland-makers stringing flowers, yet another of butchers and fishmongers, each street dense with its own tools and goods.

dialogue.text: The poem lists street after street of specialists, mapping a city by the work of its people.

i18n.hi: कविता गलियों पर गलियाँ गिनती जाती है, काम के ज़रिए शहर का नक्शा खींचती है।

panels.shot: medium shot at a gate, looking outward toward arriving traders
panels.action: At a city gate, caravan traders with cloth-wrapped bundles arrive behind pack animals; foreign-looking sailors with different hairstyles and garments step forward from the crowd, gesturing toward the city.

dialogue.text: Maduraikanci speaks of merchants from afar, of foreign wares and ship-borne goods feeding the markets of Madurai.

i18n.hi: मदुरैकाञ्चि दूर देशों के सौदागरों, परदेसी माल और जहाज़ी सामान से भरते मदुरै के बाज़ारों की बात करता है।

panels.shot: temple courtyard wide shot, balanced, serene
panels.action: Within a temple courtyard, priests perform a ritual before a stone linga; nearby, a small shrine with a goddess image; beyond the walls, a Jain monk with shaved head and a Buddhist bhikkhu in robe walk past in conversation.

dialogue.text: The poem’s Madurai is ringed with shrines and sacred groves, yet its streets also know Jain ascetics and Buddhist monks.

i18n.hi: कविता का मदुरै मंदिरों और पवित्र उपवनों से घिरा है, पर उसकी गलियों में जैन तपस्वी और बौद्ध भिक्षु भी चलते हैं।

panels.shot: close shot of a Jain monk and householder at a doorway
panels.action: A Jain monk stands at a house doorway, bowl in hand, as a householder offers food with respectful gesture; Maruthanar passes by, watching quietly, the city’s religious mix reflected in his eyes.

dialogue.text: Maduraikanci notes ascetics moving door to door, woven into the daily rhythm of a largely Brahmanical city.

i18n.hi: मदुरैकाञ्चि घर–घर फिरते साधुओं को नोट करता है, जो ज़्यादातर ब्राह्मणों वाले शहर की रोज़मर्रा की धड़कन में घुले हैं।

panels.shot: dynamic wide of a festival procession moving through streets
panels.action: A festive procession winds through the main street: musicians with drums and flutes, dancers, women carrying pots on their heads, men bearing a decorated image on a palanquin as crowds line the way.

dialogue.text: Music and procession fill Maruthanar’s lines, as he paints a city where gods travel through streets and people follow.

i18n.hi: मरुथनार की पंक्तियाँ संगीत और शोभायात्राओं से भर जाती हैं, जैसे देवता गलियों से गुजरते हैं और लोग पीछे-पीछे चलते हैं।

panels.shot: wide shot of the Vaigai riverbank at sunrise
panels.action: At dawn, the Vaigai flows broad and calm; washermen beat clothes on stones, women draw water in pots, and boats lie moored while the city’s silhouette rises beyond the far bank.

dialogue.text: He lingers on the Vaigai, that river of life, whose sands hold laundry, play, and riverine trade together.

i18n.hi: वो वैगई पर ठहर जाता है, उस जीवन-धारा पर, जिसकी रेत पर कपड़े धुलते हैं, खेल होते हैं और नदी का व्यापार भी।

panels.shot: close-up of Maruthanar’s hand writing on palm leaf
panels.action: An extreme close-up shows Maruthanar’s hand scratching Tamil letters onto a palm leaf with a stylus, his fingers stained and steady, as rolled bundles of earlier verses lie beside him.

dialogue.text: Line after line, seven hundred and more, he builds an ideal city, each detail a crafted choice.

i18n.hi: पंक्ति दर पंक्ति, सात सौ से ऊपर, वो एक आदर्श शहर गढ़ता है, हर बारीकी सोचकर चुनी हुई।

panels.shot: contrast shot: poet observing a quarrel in the street
panels.action: In a narrow lane, two men argue heatedly over a broken pot while a guard steps in; Maruthanar watches from a shaded doorway, weighing whether to let such quarrels enter his vision of Madurai.

dialogue.text: Yet Maduraikanci is no police report. It polishes, it selects, it praises more than it complains.

i18n.hi: पर मदुरैकाञ्चि कोई पुलिस रिपोर्ट नहीं है। ये तराशता है, चुनता है, शिकायत से ज़्यादा प्रशंसा करता है।

panels.shot: low-angle shot of city guard on watchtower
panels.action: A Pandya guard stands atop the city wall, spear in hand, scanning the horizon where faint dust plumes hint at distant armies; behind him, the city hums, unaware.

dialogue.text: Beyond its walls, Chera and Chola rivals contend; inside, Maruthanar’s city stands as the jewel of a contested Tamil land.

i18n.hi: दीवारों के बाहर चेर और चोल प्रतिद्वंद्वी भिड़ते हैं; भीतर मरुथनार का शहर संघर्षरत तमिल भूमि का नगीना बनकर चमकता है।

panels.shot: interior palace shot, mid-wide, court listening to recitation
panels.action: Back in the palace hall, courtiers and bards sit attentive as Maruthanar recites, his hand lifted slightly, the king leaning forward with a half-smile as the poem dwells not on victories but on markets and homes.

dialogue.speaker: mankudi_maruthanar_and_sangam_era_madurai
dialogue.text: Majesty, a city well-kept is a praise that never fades.

i18n.hi: महाराज, सजा-सँवरा शहर ऐसी बड़ाई है जो कभी पुरानी नहीं पड़ती।

panels.shot: time-shifted crossfade: ancient Madurai overlaid with an excavation trench
panels.action: Half the frame shows Maruthanar’s bustling Madurai; the other half fades into a modern-style excavation trench with brick structures and pottery emerging from the soil of the Vaigai basin.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, spades in the Vaigai plains uncover urban life, echoing but not proving every line of his song.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद वैगई के मैदानों में फावड़े चलते हैं, और उभरती शहरी ज़िंदगी उसके गीत की हर पंक्ति नहीं, पर कई गूँजें दोहराती है।

panels.shot: soft-focus shot of the poet walking away through a quieter lane at dusk
panels.action: At dusk, Maruthanar walks down a quieter street, silhouettes of houses on either side, a child playing in the dust, his palm-leaf bundle tucked under one arm as lamps begin to glow.

dialogue.text: We cannot test each scene he draws, yet through him a whole city’s daily breath survives.

i18n.hi: हम उसकी खींची हर झलक जाँचना नहीं सकते, पर उसके ज़रिए पूरे शहर की रोज़ की साँस बची रह गई है।

panels.shot: final wide shot from within the city, looking up at the night sky
panels.action: From a street corner, the view tilts up: tiled roofs, temple gopura silhouette, a watchman with lantern, and above them the clear night sky strewn with stars, as if sheltering the city in a vast dome.

dialogue.text: Maduraikanci reminds us that a civilization lives not only in kings and wars, but in the unrecorded streets it dares to sing.

i18n.hi: मदुरैकाञ्चि याद दिलाती है कि सभ्यता सिर्फ़ राजाओं और युद्धों में नहीं, उन अनलिखी गलियों में भी रहती है जिन्हें कोई गाने की हिम्मत करे।

subtitle_i18n.en: When a Poet Turned a City into Song
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब एक कवि ने शहर को गीत बना दिया
